summary: Aetherion Technologies Inc., a Vancouver-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on TSX/Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K attaching its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release dated November 12, 2026. Results cover the period ended September 30, 2026; the company highlights 85% year-over-year product revenue growth at Cespira, HPDI 3.0 production slated for Q4 2026 with equipped vehicles in early 2027, and a new high-pressure CNG/RNG platform for North America. A $25 million equity facility is noted as financing flexibility. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed; this is a routine earnings update, not a special situation.
